reference: She had her boots dyed purple last summer.
sk: Vlani si dala čižmy zafarbiť na fialovo.
cz: Loni si nechala kozačky obarvit na fialovo.

mistakes.feedback_sk: „Dyed her boots“ znamená, že farbila sama. „Dala zafarbiť“ je „had her boots dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Dyed her boots“ znamená, že barvila sama. „Nechala obarvit“ je „had her boots dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Dyed her boots” means she did it herself; for someone else doing it use “had her boots dyed”.

mistakes.text: She had dyed her boots {purple|violet} last {summer|year}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Toto je Past Perfect. Causative má poradie „had + vec + past participle“: „had her boots dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tohle je Past Perfect. Causative má pořadí „had + věc + past participle“: „had her boots dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: That is the Past Perfect. The causative order is “had + object + past participle”: “had her boots dyed”.

mistakes.text: She had her boots dye {purple|violet} last {summer|year}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Causative patrí za predmet past participle: „dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Causative patří za předmět past participle: „dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In the causative the object is followed by the past participle: “dyed”.

mistakes.text: She gave her boots to dye {purple|violet} last {summer|year}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Dala zafarbiť“ nie je „gave“. Použi Causative: „had her boots dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Dala obarvit“ není „gave“. Použij Causative: „had her boots dyed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use “gave” here. Use the causative: “had her boots dyed”.

mistakes.text: She had her boots dyed on {purple|violet} last {summer|year}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri farbe sa predložka nepíše: „dyed purple“, nie „dyed on purple“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U barvy se předložka nepíše: „dyed purple“, ne „dyed on purple“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No preposition before the colour: “dyed purple”, not “dyed on purple”.

source_issues: Slovak 'Vlani' and Czech 'Loni' mean 'last year', the English says 'last summer'; both accepted.
